brief.subject: EUDR brief: JRC forest map v4 out, November IS training set
brief.headline: JRC Releases Version 4 of 2020 Global Forest Cover Map; Commission Sets November Training
brief.dek: The JRC has updated its Global Forest Cover map for 2020, and the Commission has posted November dates for EUDR Information System training.
brief.lede: The JRC has released Version 4 of its Global Forest Cover map for the year 2020. Teams that screen plots against it should note which version they are using.

sections.heading: JRC forest map reaches Version 4
bullets: Version 4 of the Global Forest Cover map for 2020 has been released by the JRC.
The update was announced in the Commission's environment newsroom on 2026-10-19.
If your geolocation checks reference this map, record the version used in your due-diligence files.
The announcement does not detail what changed from earlier versions, so compare outputs before relying on past results.

sections.heading: November training for the Information System
bullets: The Commission has published November training dates for the EUDR Information System.
The notice was posted on 2026-10-22 as an EUDR update.
Staff who submit due-diligence statements should check the Commission's EUDR pages for the session schedule.
